derivations.claim: The periodic horizontal exponential converts the bulk Laplace equation to F''-k^2 F=0.
Solving the constant-coefficient ODE and imposing the fixed-bed Neumann condition leaves F=A cosh(k(z+h)).
The kinematic free-surface condition gives -i omega H=A k sinh(kh).
The dynamic free-surface condition gives -i omega A cosh(kh)+(g+gamma k^2/rho)H=0.
Positivity and the two boundary equations rule out omega=0 for a nonzero mode.
Eliminating A from the kinematic and dynamic amplitude equations yields the finite-depth capillary-gravity dispersion formula.
The right side is strictly positive, and the explicit amplitude/profile construction realizes both real frequency branches.
